news.summary: Q3 FY2027 revenue outlook is 108 billion USD plus or minus 2%; China Data Center compute revenue is excluded from the outlook.
Company announced third-party compute financing partnerships targeting more than 500 billion USD over time, subject to definitive agreements; this is not recognised revenue or funded cash.

comparabilityWarnings: Quarter ends in July, not September.
Reported free cash flow also subtracts principal payments of 59 million; OCF minus 2677 million purchases alone would use a different definition.
Data Center is not directly equivalent to Azure, Microsoft Cloud or Apple Services.

news.summary: Azure revenue grew 48% year over year; Microsoft Cloud revenue was 63.9 billion USD and grew 30% on a reported basis.
FY2027 segment presentation changed to Agents and Infra and Devices and Consumer; prior periods were recast in the release.

comparabilityWarnings: Three-month reporting period ends in September, unlike NVIDIA July quarter.
Cash capex excludes finance lease additions; no broader capex guidance is represented as observed cash outflow.
Agents and Infra profit must not be attributed entirely to Azure or AI.

news.summary: Q4 results were published on November 2; EPS and gross margin included favourable tariff refund effects.
Board declared a 0.27 USD cash dividend payable November 16 to holders of record November 12; declaration is not a realised investment return.

comparabilityWarnings: Company revenue and profit shown are quarterly; cash flows are full-year and must not be divided by quarterly sales.
Annual diluted EPS was 8.98 for FY2026; quarterly diluted EPS 2.10 must not be treated as TTM EPS.
Apple Services is not directly comparable to Azure or NVIDIA Data Center.

meliusFlag.limitation: Public secondary report and provider row only; original Melius note and licensed revision feed were not retrieved. This is a target cut with Buy maintained, not a rating downgrade.
